historic_survey.note: Built about 1964 as A. Sabella's Restaurant by architect Edward Wong, an example of New Formalist design in a neighbourhood commercial building. Substantially altered since - ground floor, signage, awnings, and a new balcony and replacement windows breaking the fenestration pattern - so that the statement finds it no longer retains overall integrity.
